dialogue.content: (時間になったら始めますね。よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (We'll start at the scheduled time. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いします。本日ご希望のケース等はございますでしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (I look forward to it. Do you have a preferred case for today?)

dialogue.content: （マーシーさんのケースはいつも勉強になっています。おまかせします）
dialogue.English: (I always learn so much from your cases, Marcy. I'll leave it up to you.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます。かしこまりました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. Understood.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。よろしかったら初めに、性別と年齢を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor. If you're comfortable, could you please start by telling me your gender and age?
35, male.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: もう生きていけません
dialogue.English: I can't go on living anymore.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...おつらい中、来てくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.English: I see... Thank you for coming here today, especially when you're feeling so much pain.

dialogue.content: 少し詳しい状況教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a bit more about what’s been going on?

dialogue.content: 離婚しました
dialogue.English: I got divorced.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか...お話してくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.English: I see... Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: 今の状況はいつごろからでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How long has this situation been going on?

dialogue.content: 先月から
dialogue.English: Since last month.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね..
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 今、どんなお気持ちですか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: 寂しい
dialogue.English: Lonely.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...そうですよね...寂しいですよね
dialogue.English: I see... Yes, that makes sense... It must be lonely.

dialogue.content: お食事や睡眠はとれていますか？
dialogue.English: Are you managing to eat and sleep properly?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: おつらいですね...
dialogue.English: That must be so difficult...

dialogue.content: 今まで一緒にいた、大切な方がいなくなるのは...本当に寂しいですよね...
dialogue.English: Losing someone important who has always been by your side... it must be incredibly lonely...

dialogue.content: 体の一部がもぎ取られたような...
dialogue.English: It feels like a part of your body has been torn away...

dialogue.content: 胸が詰まる思いを抱えていらっしゃるのではないかと思いますが...いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: I imagine you're feeling a tightness in your chest... How does that sound?

dialogue.content: よくわかりません
dialogue.English: I don't really know.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: お話しできる範囲でいいので...
dialogue.English: Only as much as you feel comfortable sharing...

dialogue.content: 経緯など、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me how things came to this?

dialogue.content: 何の
dialogue.English: About what?

dialogue.content: 離婚された経緯など..
dialogue.English: The circumstances of the divorce, for example...

dialogue.content: 話しにくいです
dialogue.English: It's hard to talk about.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 今、お仕事などはどうですか？
dialogue.English: How are things with work right now?

dialogue.content: どうって
dialogue.English: What do you mean?

dialogue.content: お仕事はされていますか？
dialogue.English: Are you working?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。つらいお気持ちの中、お仕事には影響はないですか？
dialogue.English: I see. While you're going through this difficult time, has it had any impact on your work?

dialogue.content: 多少は
dialogue.English: Somewhat.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: とてもしんどい状況だと思いますが..
dialogue.English: I imagine this is a very difficult situation for you...

dialogue.content: きちんとお仕事はされて、お気持ちのコントロールもされているんでしょうか...
dialogue.English: It seems you're managing to go to work and keep your feelings in check...

dialogue.content: 頑張っていらっしゃるんですね...
dialogue.English: You're working so hard through this...

dialogue.content: どんなことでもいいので...
dialogue.English: You can talk about anything at all...

dialogue.content: 今日は頑張らず、安心してお話してもらえたらうれしいです
dialogue.English: I hope you can feel safe to talk today, without feeling like you have to push yourself.

dialogue.content: 何を知りたいの
dialogue.English: What do you want to know?

dialogue.content: 重たいお気持ちを少しでも分かち合えたら
dialogue.English: I was hoping I could share some of the heavy burden you're carrying.

dialogue.content: それでどうなるの
dialogue.English: And what will that accomplish?

dialogue.content: そうですね...
dialogue.English: That's a fair question...

dialogue.content: 私には何もできないかもしれないですが...
dialogue.English: I may not be able to do anything to change it...

dialogue.content: おひとりで抱えるよりは荷が軽くなることもあるかと感じています...
dialogue.English: ...but I believe the burden can feel lighter than when you carry it all by yourself.

dialogue.content: 軽くなってもどうせ変わりませんよね
dialogue.English: Even if it feels lighter, nothing will change anyway, right?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね..そう思っていらっしゃるんですね..
dialogue.English: I see... so that's what you believe.

dialogue.content: 一番しんどい渦中にいる今は、そう思うのももっともだと思います
dialogue.English: When you're in the midst of such intense pain, it's completely understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: なので、一番つらい今を何とかしのぐために...
dialogue.English: So, to somehow get through this most difficult time...

dialogue.content: お気持ちを聞くことくらいはできるかもしれないと思います...
dialogue.English: I believe I can at least listen to how you’re feeling...

dialogue.content: 聞いても状況は変わりませんよね
dialogue.English: Listening won’t change the situation, will it?

dialogue.content: そうですね...状況は変わらないかもしれないですよね
dialogue.English: You're right... the situation itself may not change.

dialogue.content: あなたは、どうしたいと思っていますか？
dialogue.English: What is it that you would like to do?

dialogue.content: 全くわかりません
dialogue.English: I have no idea at all.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: わからないですよね...
dialogue.English: It’s hard to know, isn’t it...

dialogue.content: お食事もあまりとれてないようですが...
dialogue.English: You mentioned you haven't been eating much...

dialogue.content: わからない上で聞いたの
dialogue.English: Did you ask me that knowing I wouldn't have an answer?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I did.

dialogue.content: どういうつもりですか
dialogue.English: What was your intention in doing that?

dialogue.content: 聞いた後で、確かに、と思いました
dialogue.English: After I asked, I realized you were right.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさいね
dialogue.English: I'm sorry about that.

dialogue.content: 私でもきっと
dialogue.English: I'm sure that even I...

dialogue.content: 一番しんどい時にはわからないよな...と
dialogue.English: ...wouldn't know what to do when I'm in the most pain.

dialogue.content: それがわかるなら..
dialogue.English: If I knew the answer to that...

dialogue.content: 楽になっているかも...tと思いました。
dialogue.English: ...I'd probably already be feeling better, I thought.

dialogue.content: そもそも1番しんどいなんて言いましたっけ
dialogue.English: Did I ever say I was in the 'most' pain?

dialogue.content: そうですね..私の推測かもしれません
dialogue.English: You’re right... that may have been my assumption.

dialogue.content: 生きていけないと感じるくらい...
dialogue.English: Feeling like you can't go on living...

dialogue.content: しんどいのだから、さぞかししんどいのだろうと..
dialogue.English: ...is so difficult, so I assumed it must be incredibly painful.

dialogue.content: どういう意味ですか
dialogue.English: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: そうですね、私がお話うかがっていて、推測しただけだと思います
dialogue.English: Well, I think I was just making an assumption based on what I was hearing from you.

dialogue.content: お食事も睡眠もままならないとおっしゃっていたので...
dialogue.English: You mentioned you aren't able to eat or sleep properly...

dialogue.content: 体調はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: How is your physical health?

dialogue.content: 辛い
dialogue.English: I feel awful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 具合が悪いところはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anywhere specific that feels unwell?

dialogue.content: それ必要？
dialogue.English: Is that necessary?

dialogue.content: そうですね...心配なので聞きました
dialogue.English: Well... I asked because I am concerned.

dialogue.content: どこがつらいのか..
dialogue.English: About where you're feeling the pain...

dialogue.content: 知ってどうするのです
dialogue.English: What will you do with that information?

dialogue.content: か
そうですね...体の不調は変えられるかもしれないと
dialogue.English: I was thinking that physical discomfort might be something we could change.

dialogue.content: その根拠は
dialogue.English: What's your basis for that?

dialogue.content: そうですね...根拠はないですが、出来ることもあるとは思います
dialogue.English: Well... I don't have any specific evidence, but I do think there are things that can be done.

dialogue.content: それから...
dialogue.English: And also...

dialogue.content: じゃあ簡単に言わないで
dialogue.English: Then don't say it so casually.

dialogue.content: そう思われるんですね
dialogue.English: I see that's how it came across.

dialogue.content: 簡単に聞こえたらごめんなさい
dialogue.English: I'm sorry if it sounded casual.

dialogue.content: あなたのお気持ちを身近にお話できるひとはいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone close to you that you can talk to about your feelings?

dialogue.content: いません
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね..
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 日常生活で困っていることはありますか？
dialogue.English: Are you having trouble with anything in your daily life?

dialogue.content: 色々
dialogue.English: Various things.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 掃除とか洗濯とか食事とか...
dialogue.English: Like cleaning, laundry, meals...

dialogue.content: お困りですか？
dialogue.English: Are you having trouble with them?

dialogue.content: だから色々って言ってます
dialogue.English: That’s why I said various things.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: もし、誰かに頼めるとしたら...いかがですか？
dialogue.English: If you could ask someone for help... how would that be?

dialogue.content: いません
dialogue.English: There’s no one.

dialogue.content: 地域の社会福祉協議会というところがあって...
dialogue.English: There is a place called the local Social Welfare Council...

dialogue.content: ワーカーさんがお手伝いしてくれると思いますが...
dialogue.English: ...where a case worker could assist you, I believe.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか?
dialogue.English: How would you feel about that?

dialogue.content: よくわからないので、結構です
dialogue.English: I don't really know what that is, so no thank you.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 眠れないときなど、どうしていますか？
dialogue.English: What do you do when you can't sleep?

dialogue.content: 特に何も
dialogue.English: Nothing in particular.

dialogue.content: 眠れずにお仕事されたりしているんですか？
dialogue.English: Do you go to work even when you haven't slept?

dialogue.content: だからどうしましたか
dialogue.English: So what if I do?

dialogue.content: そうですね...倒れてしまわないかと
dialogue.English: Well... I'm concerned that you might collapse.

dialogue.content: 気になっています...
dialogue.English: That worries me...

dialogue.content: 余計なお世話です
dialogue.English: It’s none of your business.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...そう感じていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: I understand... That’s how it feels to you.

dialogue.content: おしゃっていたように...
dialogue.English: As you said...

dialogue.content: 状況は変わらないかもしれないし、何も変わらないと思われるかもしれませんが...
dialogue.English: The situation may not change, and you may feel that nothing will change, but...

dialogue.content: 今日みたいに、またお話ししに来てくれたら、一緒に方法を模索してみたいと思いますが...いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: If you would be willing to come and talk again like you did today, I'd like to try and explore some options together. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: いやだ
dialogue.English: I don’t want to.

dialogue.content: (それでも終了の方向でお願いします)
dialogue.English: (Please proceed with ending the session anyway.)

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...でももし気が変わったら、お待ちしていますね..本日はお話聞かせてくれてありがとうございました（長引いてすみません）
dialogue.English: I understand... but if you change your mind, I'll be here for you. Thank you for talking with me today. (I'm sorry this ran long.)

dialogue.content: 今日の相談はいったん終了してもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright to end our session for today?

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした。このまま終了メッセージ送信でロープレ完了お願いします。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the session. Please send the final closing message to complete the role-play.)

dialogue.content: （これでロープレ終了します。ありがとございました。またよろしくおねがいします）
dialogue.English: (This concludes the role-play. Thank you very much. I look forward to our next session.)
